#### `dvz_box_extent()` { #dvz_box_extent .dvz-api-function }

Return the extent of a box, in the same coordinate system, depending on the target viewport
aspect ratio. `DVZ_BOX_EXTENT_DEFAULT` returns the input box unchanged. `EXPAND` preserves the
center and grows the smaller axis so the returned box contains the input. `CONTRACT` preserves
the center and shrinks the larger axis so the returned box is contained by the input.

```c
DvzBox dvz_box_extent(
    DvzBox box,
    float width,
    float height,
    DvzBoxExtentStrategy strategy
);
```

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| return | [`DvzBox`](runtime-math.md#type-dvzbox) | adjusted extent box |
| `box` | [`DvzBox`](runtime-math.md#type-dvzbox) | the original box |
| `width` | `float` | target viewport width in arbitrary units; nonpositive values leave the box unchanged |
| `height` | `float` | target viewport height in the same units as @p width; nonpositive values leave the box unchanged |
| `strategy` | [`DvzBoxExtentStrategy`](runtime-math.md#type-dvzboxextentstrategy) | indicates how the extent box should be computed |

_Declared in `include/datoviz/math/box.h`:126._

```c
);
```

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |

| `boxes` | `const` [`DvzBox`](runtime-math.md#type-dvzbox) * | input array containing @p box_count boxes; must not be NULL when @p box_count is positive |
| `strategy` | [`DvzBoxMergeStrategy`](runtime-math.md#type-dvzboxmergestrategy) | the merge strategy |

## Normalize { #normalize }

<p class="dvz-api-kind-label" role="heading" aria-level="3"><strong>Functions</strong></p>

#### `dvz_normalize_bytes()` { #dvz_normalize_bytes .dvz-api-function }

Map floating-point values linearly to unsigned bytes.

Values at or below the selected minimum map to 0, and values at or above the maximum map to
255. When both bounds are equal, the effective maximum is `minimum + 1`.

```c
void dvz_normalize_bytes(
    vec2 min_max,
    uint32_t count,
    float * values,
    uint8_t * out
);
```

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `min_max` | [`vec2`](runtime-math.md#type-vec2) | input bounds `{minimum, maximum}`; minimum must not exceed maximum |
| `count` | `uint32_t` | number of values; must be positive |
| `values` | `float` * | input array containing @p count values; must not be NULL |
| `out` | `uint8_t` * |  |

_Declared in `include/datoviz/math/stats.h`:66._

## Threads { #threads }

<p class="dvz-api-kind-label" role="heading" aria-level="3"><strong>Functions</strong></p>

#### `dvz_threads_default()` { #dvz_threads_default .dvz-api-function }

Set the number of threads to use in OpenMP-aware functions based on DVZ_NUM_THREADS, or take
half of dvz_num_procs().

```c
DvzResult dvz_threads_default(void);
```

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| return | [`DvzResult`](runtime-utilities.md#type-dvzresult) | DVZ_OK on success, DVZ_ERROR on validation error or when OpenMP is unavailable |

_Declared in `include/datoviz/math/parallel.h`:70._

#### `dvz_threads_get()` { #dvz_threads_get .dvz-api-function }

Get the number of threads to use in OpenMP-aware functions.

```c
int dvz_threads_get(void);
```

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| return | `int` | configured OpenMP thread count, or zero before configuration or when OpenMP is unavailable |

_Declared in `include/datoviz/math/parallel.h`:60._

#### `dvz_threads_set()` { #dvz_threads_set .dvz-api-function }

Set the number of threads to use in OpenMP-aware functions.

Positive values request an absolute count. Nonpositive values are interpreted relative to the
processor count (`-1` means all but one processor); the resolved count must be positive.

```c
DvzResult dvz_threads_set(
    int num_threads
);
```

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| return | [`DvzResult`](runtime-utilities.md#type-dvzresult) | DVZ_OK on success, DVZ_ERROR on validation error or when OpenMP is unavailable |
| `num_threads` | `int` | absolute or processor-relative requested thread count |

_Declared in `include/datoviz/math/parallel.h`:51._
